result_summary.title: Autoscaling Failure and Rate Limit Issues in Staging
result_summary.description: In our APAC staging environment, the Rate Limiter is throwing 'rate limit exceeded' errors even though traffic is low. We also noticed that autoscaling is not triggering for the associated service. It's unclear if the problem is within the Rate Limiter configuration itself or if the VPN Gateway is causing connectivity issues that prevent the autoscaler from reaching the control plane. We are the only users testing this right now, so impact is low, but we need to know which component is at fault to debug the scaling behavior.
